content.short: A social, cooperative massive multiplayer online (MMO) NFT Game focused around NFTs that you can customize and mint!
content.description:
Flooftopia is a kid-friendly (but not kid-exclusive) cooperative MMO NFT game where users will be able to build their own NFTs, known as "Floofs." Flooftopia is the first NFT project that will allow the user to create, customize, and build their own NFT.

But what do we mean by "users will be able to build their own NFTs?"

We mean that users won't have to enter a grab bag-like process just hoping to get an NFT that they will like and love to use within Flooftopia. Users will be able to customize their baseline Floof (NFT) in a manner similar to Build-a-Bear. Once the user is content with how their Floof (NFT) looks, they will be able to mint their own unique Floof (NFT)!

As for gameplay, the Flooftopia universe aims at providing a fun, social environment with non-combat-oriented gameplay. As previously noted, it will be a kid-friendly (but not kid-exclusive) game that caters to broader demographics beyond the typical gaming and crypto trading communities. The gameplay will have typical elements of MMOs, like leveling and player interaction. We also want to provide a bit of Tamagotchi to the Floofs. That is to say, users will be able to tend to their Floof as a digital companion and this will have effects within the game. The current plan encompasses the NFT pre-sale, a possible NFT Marketplace, and, of course, the Flooftopia game on PC (with the goal of eventually releasing mobile versions for iOS and Android).

The project is supported by LOOPS pool for integration of Cardano's additional functions.
